iraq.cso.private-construction-estimates-.access: Official 2024 estimated private-sector building report, Table 15 material quantities and costs. The estimates combine 2024 building permits and 2024 material/wage bulletins with execution/material-use ratios from the 2012 survey. Ratios of reported estimated cost to estimated quantity are historical statistical cross-checks, not observed supplier transactions, railway-specific prices, awarded rates, or installed costs. Kurdistan Region is excluded.
iraq.cso.private-construction-estimates-.geographic_scope: Baghdad governorate and Iraq aggregate; national aggregate excludes Kurdistan Region
iraq.cso.private-construction-estimates-.methodology: Estimated construction quantities and costs use 2024 permits, 2024 market-price/wage bulletin, and execution/material-use ratios from the 2012 private-building survey; not transaction records.
